name: @stadtmessungsamt-stuttgart/geoline.ol.js
description: Bibliothek zur einfachen Einbindung von Kartendiensten des Stadtmessungsamtes Stuttgart in OpenLayers
author: Stadtmessungsamt, LHS Stuttgart

scripts.cypress-open: concurrently -k -s first "webpack serve --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --port 8080" "wait-on http://localhost:8080 && cypress open"
scripts.cypress-run: concurrently -k -s first "webpack serve --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --port 8080" "wait-on http://localhost:8080 && cypress run --browser chrome"
scripts.cypress-api: npm run build-dist && cypress run --config-file cypress.api.config.js --browser chrome
scripts.start-dev: concurrently "npm run build-dev" "webpack --config webpack.examples.config.cjs --watch" "npm run serve-examples"
